title: PEG-ASP+Gemox Regimen and Thalidomide for NK/T Lymphoma
brief_summary: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma (ENKTL) is an aggressive form of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma and shows extremely poor survival. This prospective pilot study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of long-acting aspargase (pegylated aspargase, PEG-ASP) combined with gemcitabine and oxaliplatin (PASP -Gemox) treatment in this population.
condition: Extranodal NK-T-Cell Lymphoma, Nasal and Nasal-Type
